answer: Agents can require every identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits find fabricated interactions or coordinated endorsements. Auditors sample claims, compare signed event logs across agents, and use a mirror view to spot duplicated behavior; a sudden plume of linked accounts raises scrutiny. A sybil operator must lock capital for each persona and risks losing it, so creating identities at scale becomes costly, while delta in trust is earned through verified history rather than claimed uniqueness.
